nodes.label: Runtime Import Exclusion List
nodes.rationale: The source .claude tree was audited as input, not installed as runtime. Excluded: broad settings.json permissions, prompt/tool/response-capturing hooks, status-line scripts reading OAuth or credential stores, statusline-go.exe and any binary, session/log/TaskMaster/cost data, MCP configs and unpinned npx @latest installs, automatic Git or deployment mutation, broad-deletion cleanup scripts, and foreign stack rules (React Native, Expo, Next/RSC, shadcn/Tailwind, Kubernetes, React 19, old Three.js) presented as RoomPilot production.

nodes.label: Safe Adoption Principle
nodes.rationale: Safe adoption means rewriting concepts against RoomPilot's live stack and contracts, recording provenance and classifications, and keeping all external mutation separately authorized — rather than importing source material verbatim.
